plain_english_summary: Deterministic trajectory compression with H3 spatial indexing for geospatial telemetry and movement traces; maneuver search exists, but the committed AV benchmark currently reports p@10 mean 0.33.
commercial_wedge: Store and spatially index large movement traces economically. The present wedge is deterministic compression plus H3-backed retrieval for fleet routes, vessel tracks, and logistics traces; maneuver search quality is currently weak on the committed benchmark path.
technical_wedge: Deterministic geospatial encoding using 8-compass direction primitives with magnitude quantisation and RLE, plus H3 roundtrip validation and spatial query surfaces. Current committed AV maneuver benchmark: p@10 mean 0.33 (left_turn 0.0, lane_merge 0.0, stop 1.0).
ideal_first_buyer: Mobility analytics platform or fleet telematics team
deployment_model: SDK — Python package with H3 spatial backend
not_claimed: Strong maneuver-search quality; current committed AV benchmark is p@10 mean 0.33 (left_turn 0.0, lane_merge 0.0, stop 1.0)
family_position: Product candidate in the Zer0pa deterministic encoding family. ZPE-IMC is the umbrella integration layer.
